kind: Referral letter from a family practice to a cardiologist
header: 27 Station Road, Pine Hollow, PA 18433 | Phone 570-555-0118 | Fax 570-555-0119

body.p: RE: Thomas Abernathy    DOB: 11/22/1959    MRN: TA-553021    Insurance member ID: KXP884120367

Thank you for seeing Mr. Abernathy, a 66-year-old man with exertional chest pain over the past two months. The pain is substernal, comes on after climbing one flight of stairs and settles within five minutes of rest. He is a former smoker with a 30 pack-year history, and his father died of a myocardial infarction at 58.

An exercise stress test on October 21, 2026 showed 2 mm ST depression in the lateral leads at 6 METs. LDL cholesterol is 162 mg/dL and blood pressure in clinic was 142/88. I have started Aspirin 81 mg daily and Atorvastatin 40 mg nightly, and given Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg sublingual as needed.
Tom works nights, so his wife Linda usually handles scheduling. She can be reached at 570-555-0164, or you can email him at tabernathy59@example.com. They live at 6 Birchwood Terrace in Pine Hollow.
I would be grateful for your assessment and your advice on whether coronary angiography is indicated.
